pokedexEntries.rb: Capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

pokedexEntries.ye: Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

pokedexEntries.go: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.

pokedexEntries.si: Its fin-tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

pokedexEntries.cr: The male raises the young. If it is approached, it uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.

pokedexEntries.ru: SEADRA sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this POKéMON’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.

pokedexEntries.sa: SEADRA generates whirlpools by spinning its body. The whirlpools are strong enough to swallow even fishing boats. This POKéMON weakens prey with these currents, then swallows it whole.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

pokedexEntries.lg: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

pokedexEntries.em: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

pokedexEntries.hg: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.

pokedexEntries.ss: Its fin-tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.

pokedexEntries.x: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

pokedexEntries.y: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

pokedexEntries.or: Seadra sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this Pokémon’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.

pokedexEntries.as: Seadra generates whirlpools by spinning its body. The whirlpools are strong enough to swallow even fishing boats. This Pokémon weakens prey with these currents, then swallows it whole.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

pokedexEntries.sw: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

pokedexEntries.sh: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

pokedexEntries.sc: The male raises the young. If it is approached while caring for young, it will use its toxic spines to fend off the intruder.

pokedexEntries.vi: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.
